tests.name: user_context_stores_and_exposes_user_identifier
tests.historical_review: Reviewed default environment USER then USERNAME then main, process and thread identity shape, explicit user-123 setter, user-456 builder, optional user-789 then None and optional user-abc builder. Expected identity is independently constructed. C++ native thread ID explicitly adapts Rust process-local ThreadId; no literal cross-language thread-number equivalence is claimed.

tests.name: local_lock_enforces_ownership_timeout_and_lease_expiry
tests.historical_review: Reviewed exact seven acquire/reject/unlock decisions with two Users, zero timeout, 50ms lease and actual 60ms expiry wait. Both Users share one application-owned Global lock directory; isolated generated key replaces source wall-clock debug key without changing ownership/lease behavior.

tests.name: remote_lock_delegates_and_preserves_context_ownership
tests.historical_review: Reviewed all seven provider acquisition/rejection/unlock outcomes and absent-provider optional success. Actual UserContext async delegation uses explicit Global test provider rebinding instead of Arc; owner-only test map mirrors source Mutex map on owner thread, timeout 0 and expiry 1000 preserved. No cloud provider is introduced.
